stdout: tandem-cli ticket set — edit one ticket's fields in one write.
status    backlog | on-hold | selected | ready | in-progress | in-review | done
assignee  a name, `self` ($TANDEM_AGENT), or "" for the unassigned
A flag not named leaves its field alone. `--description -` reads the body
from stdin; `--description ""` clears the description deliberately.
`--append-description` appends after a blank line, or writes the bare text
when the body is empty; `-` reads the addition from stdin. An empty addition
is refused, and naming `--description` with `--append-description` is refused;
the description is left as it was.
